title: Branch Closing
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the Scranton branch faces the threat of closure, causing widespread anxiety among employees. Michael initially reacts with disbelief and anger but plans to confront the CFO in New York to save the branch. Jan later reveals that the Scranton branch will remain open while Stamford will close, leading to a merger where some Stamford employees will transfer to Scranton. Jim is offered the number two position at Scranton and decides to accept it, encouraging Karen to consider a job there as well. The episode ends with relief and celebration as the Scranton branch is confirmed to stay open.
